versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the market-tick skill.
- Provides real-time cross-asset snapshots (price, volume, spread) from APEX Runner's live trading system.
- Supports Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid exchanges.
- Accessible via authenticated GET request with only an EVM wallet (no API key or subscription needed).
- Usage examples and pricing tiers included.
- Related signals and documentation provided.
